dslRule:
<!id: unused.throwable.allocation.to.throw>
<!description: Transforms an unused throwable object allocation statement into a throw statement. This typically fixes a compiler warning about an unused object allocation where the object is an exception that should have been thrown.
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: bug-fix, error-prone, problem-fix>

new $Type($args$); :: subtypeOf($Type, "java.lang.Throwable")
=>
throw new $Type($args$);
;;
summary: Transforms an unused `new Throwable(...)` statement into `throw new Throwable(...)`.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
